message.content:
I need to redesign a React JSX file into a proper documentation dashboard like documentation.ai/docs.

## Current State
- Single JSX file at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Operation/Boldteq Saas Flow Set up/boldteq-saas-flow-setup.jsx`
- ~1400 lines, light theme, 14 sections with sidebar nav
- Uses: React useState, Lucide icons, Tailwind CSS, Inter/Instrument Serif/JetBrains Mono fonts
- Currently a long single-page scroll with sticky sidebar

## Reference: documentation.ai/docs
Key features to replicate:
1. **Top navbar** — Logo left, search bar center (with Cmd+K shortcut), version badge right
2. **Search functionality** — Modal overlay with Cmd+K, filters through all content, shows results grouped by section
3. **Left sidebar** — Collapsible section groups with icons, active state highlighting, scrollable
4. **Page-based navigation** — Instead of scrolling one long page, clicking a sidebar item shows ONLY that section's content (like switching pages)
5. **Clean content area** — Full width content with proper heading hierarchy
6. **Breadcrumbs** — Show current section path at top of content

## Requirements
- Keep ALL existing content (14 sections with all their data)
- Single JSX file (no routing library)
- Light, smooth UI (already have this)
- **Search bar** that filters through section titles AND content items (rules, checklist items, tech stack names, etc.)
- **Cmd+K** keyboard shortcut to focus search
- **Page-based view** — sidebar click shows only that section, not scroll
- **Collapsible sidebar groups** — group sections logically:
  - Getting Started: Overview, Stack A
  - Infrastructure: Env Mapping, Deploy Flow, GitHub, Railway, Supabase
  - Security & Payments: Auth & Security, Billing
  - Operations: Monitoring, Quality Gates, Non-Negotiables
  - Setup: Setup Checklist, Changelog
- **Breadcrumbs** at top of content area
- **Clean topbar** with logo, search, version info

## Design Direction
- Background: white/slate-50 (keep current)
- Sidebar: white bg, slate-200 border-right, ~260px wide
- Topbar: white bg, border-bottom, height ~56px
- Content: max-w-4xl centered in remaining space
- Search modal: centered overlay with backdrop blur
- Accent: indigo (keep current)
- Cards: keep current rounded-xl shadow-sm style

## State Management
```
activePage: string (which section is shown)
searchOpen: boolean (search modal)
searchQuery: string
collapsedGroups: Record<string, boolean>
checkedItems: Record<string, boolean> (existing)
```

## Searchable Content Index
Build a flat array of searchable items:
- Section titles and subtitles
- Each rule text
- Each checklist item
- Each tech stack item name
- Each forbidden item
- Each security checklist item
- Each quality gate check

Search results should show: item text, which section it belongs to, clicking navigates to that section.

## Component Structure
- `BoldteqDocs` (main) — manages state, renders layout
- `Topbar` — logo, search trigger, version
- `Sidebar` — collapsible groups with section links
- `SearchModal` — overlay with input, filtered results
- `Breadcrumb` — shows group > section
- Content sections remain as-is (just rendered conditionally)
- All existing sub-components stay unchanged

Plan the full implementation with specific details on:
1. How to restructure the main component
2. Search index structure and filtering logic
3. Sidebar group structure
4. Keyboard shortcut implementation
5. Layout CSS (fixed sidebar + topbar, scrollable content)
